decisions.executionNote: Begin elbow-up approach with both arms in their own workspaces; left toward wooden car, right toward the right rabbit. Grippers remain open.
Rotate toward downward approaches while moving over the wooden car and right rabbit, staying separated and above the objects.
Align jaws with the narrow dimensions of the car and rabbit while descending cautiously; visual grasp centers remain uncertain.
Refine car jaw orientation and lower both open grippers toward object height, with small lateral corrections from the head and wrist views.
Center the left jaws on the wooden car before closing; close the right gripper on the rabbit torso and begin a small retention-test lift.
Lift both closed grasps to verify retention, then begin carrying the wooden car toward the white basket and rabbit toward the red basket.
RGB shows both objects remained on the table. Reopen and return for deeper grasps, using small corrections rather than assuming the closed commands retained them.
Close at a lower car grasp and shift the right jaws toward the rabbit torso before closing. Lift a few centimeters to check actual retention in RGB.
Both objects now appear between the jaws after the test lift. Keep closure, gain rim clearance, and carry car toward white and rabbit toward red without crossing arms.
Replan after the rejected suffix with smaller steps. Tilt the retained objects forward into their baskets while lowering the wrists, avoiding excessive extension.
Lower slightly into the white and red baskets, open to release the car and rabbit, then withdraw vertically to inspect settling.
Car and rabbit are visibly released in separate baskets. Move toward the left and right green watches for the blue basket, restoring downward grasp orientations.
Approach the green watch bands with open jaws, correcting forward alignment from RGB and descending gradually toward grasp height.
Center the right watch between the jaws, lower both a little into the bands, close, and perform short lifts to verify retention.
Test the left watch retention with a further lift. The right watch appears below the closed jaws; reopen, correct toward its band, close lower, and test again.
The left watch stays fixed in the wrist view during lifting. Carry it toward the blue basket while lifting the right watch to verify retention; keep the arms separated.
Carry the retained left watch over the blue basket. The right watch stayed on the table, so reopen and approach its solid face rather than the center of its loop.
Place the left watch fully over the blue interior and release. Correct the right approach from its wrist view, close lower on the face/strap region, and test with a short lift.
Corrected rejected tensor; no preceding motion occurred. Withdraw left toward the remaining rabbit and recenter the open right gripper over the displaced green watch.
Refine the left rabbit approach with downward wrist alignment. Bring the right watch loop between the jaws, close near band height, and test retention with a small lift.
Hold the right watch closure through a larger retention-test lift. Lower the left jaws around the rabbit torso, close, and start lifting cautiously.
The right watch now follows the gripper in RGB. Carry it toward blue while lifting the left rabbit to test retention; maintain fore-aft separation near the center.
Release the retained watch inside blue. Set the retained rabbit down near the center as a staging transfer so the right arm can deliver it to red without crossing the arms.
Both green watches are visible in blue. Withdraw the left arm clear of the staged rabbit and move the open right gripper toward the remaining black watch.
Lower the right gripper toward the black watch with a modest forward correction; keep left clear while inspecting final jaw alignment.
Center the black watch loop between the jaws, close at band height, and test the grasp with a short vertical lift.
Lift the black watch with closure maintained, then carry it toward the blue basket while leaving the left arm clear and preserving elbow-up continuity.
Move the retained black watch away from the blue rim, lower into the interior, then open and begin withdrawing to inspect category completion.
All three watches appear in blue. Approach the mint car with the right arm to stage it at the shared center for the left arm, avoiding a cross-workspace carry.
Descend with the open right jaws aligned across the mint car's width, making a small forward correction before closing.
Close the right jaws around the mint car at side height and lift slightly to verify that it follows before staging it for the left arm.
Keep the mint car closed, lift clear, and stage it at the center boundary with a slight inward wrist tilt. Left remains stationary to avoid crossing or collision.
The mint car slipped during the lift. Reopen, align across its new orientation, and approach lower for a grasp on the body rather than the roof.
Make a small centering correction onto the mint car's body, close fully, and lift vertically without rotating to test a more stable grasp.
The car is now seated firmly between the jaws in RGB. Move it slowly to a center staging position with closure maintained and only a small wrist tilt.
Set the retained car on the center staging area and release, then separate the arms before the left approaches. Align the left jaws with the car's new orientation.
The mint car is released near the center. Bring the left arm above it while withdrawing the right arm to its own side, keeping the staged rabbit undisturbed.
Descend the left open jaws onto the staged mint car, keeping its wrist on the left side of the center boundary. Right remains clear until the car is secured.
Close the left gripper on the staged car after a small alignment and depth adjustment, then perform a short vertical retention test.
The left car appears retained. Lift and carry it toward white, then bring the right open gripper toward the staged rabbit after the left clears the center.
Carry the retained car over white with rim clearance. Align the right jaws across the staged rabbit's head and lower carefully, keeping the right wrist on its side of the center.
Release the mint car beside the wooden car inside white. The right wrist met contact near the rabbit head; close from its observed pose without forcing further descent, then test a small lift.
Two cars and three watches are visibly released in their baskets. Withdraw and reorient the left arm toward origin while lifting the rabbit with closed right jaws before carrying it to red.
The rabbit slipped back onto the left side of the table. Clear the right arm and approach its narrower torso with the left arm for a more secure staging transfer.
Align the left jaws across the rabbit's blue torso and descend gradually, keeping the right arm clear and avoiding the bulky head.
Make a small torso-centering correction, close the left jaws below the rabbit's shoulders, and test retention with a short lift.
The rabbit rotated into the center and is not retained. Withdraw the left hand and align the right jaws across its torso's new narrow direction, remaining on the right side.
Keep the right wrist on its side and angle its fingers toward the centered rabbit torso, correcting jaw orientation above it. Continue withdrawing the open left arm toward origin.
Refine the right approach onto the blue torso rather than the head, lowering with open jaws. Ease the left arm back close to its origin pose.
Shift the right grasp toward the visible blue waist and away from the oversized head, lower slightly, and close without lifting yet.
Keep closure on the rabbit waist and lift vertically to verify retention, while settling the open left arm back at its origin.
The rabbit remains fixed between the jaws during lifting. Maintain closure, gain clearance, and carry it slowly toward the red basket while easing the wrist toward vertical.
Carry the retained rabbit over the red basket with a slight forward tilt, keeping the left arm open at origin and preserving clearance over the basket rim.
Lower the retained rabbit beside its category mate, open fully inside the red basket, and begin withdrawing gently to check that both settle inside.
Both rabbits are released in red. Withdraw the open right gripper upward and back, gradually restoring its origin orientation without disturbing the sorted objects.
The sorted objects appear settled. Continue the open right arm's smooth return toward origin, with the left arm stationary at origin.
